He's 100% an abuser, I didn't know you could think the other way. Although I like the movie, I acknowledge the film is about this broken girl who fell for this sick man. A deep and disturbing dive into obsession, violence and how this two things takes part in some relationships 

IMHO ofc :)

I saw this movie in Quad Cinema in NYC circa 2018. Although much has been said about this film dealing with the killer and the woman played wonderfully by the underrated Elina Lowensohn. I did not get one hint about the girl chasing after the 'bad boy' but rather someone that is sick that is attracted to another person that is sick.
